description: OMEGAlpes (Optimization ModEls Generation As Linear Programming for Energy Systems) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by G2Elab. OMEGAlpes stands for Generation of Optimization Models As Linear Programming for Energy Systems. It aims to be an energy systems modelling tool for linear optimisation (LP, MILP). It is currently based on the LP modeler PuLP. Coverage: user-defined regions (as stated on the fact sheet). The fact sheet classes it as: Production, consumption, conversion, storage. Sectors: Electricity, Heat, all. Data availability is given as "some". The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Apache-2.0 (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
